test_title: PYST 58: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: P can do a piece of work in 15 days, while Q can do it in 10 days. If they work on alternate days beginning with P, in how many days will the work be finished?
solution:
**Given**

Time taken by P to complete the work alone: 15 days

Time taken by Q to complete the work alone: 10 days

**Concept used:**

Total work done is the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of individual work days, and the work done by P and Q alternately can be calculated from the total work done.

**Solution:**

LCM of 15
